rules.name: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
rules.description: Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
bola_events
| where bola has_any("api", "bola", "idor", "authorization")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold

rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
authentication_events
| where authentication has_any("api", "authentication", "default-credentials", "brute-force")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
